titleNative: 用務員さんは勇者じゃありませんので
synopsis: A certain girl genius with more power than knowledge accidentally summoned dozens of students and teachers into a dangerous world filled with beasts and magic, but the protagonist isn’t a student or the homeroom teacher… it’s the janitor. At the time of their summoning, the students and teachers each gained a power formed from their soul, but not the janitor. As the janitor was about to be bestowed with a power that would protect him, his power was forcibly taken from him by an arrogant student. Having gone three years without a contract extension, he failed to get a job after having graduated from a third-rate university. Somehow he is still a contractor at 25 years old and was a janitor for 2 years, with a take-home monthly salary of less than ¥120,000. From a society that rejected him, he was thrust into a world that rejected him. And what janitor-san wished from the Goddess who took pity on him was…

synonyms: She Who Returned from Death Wishing to End the Repeating World
synopsis: I can't die yet...! A loop mystery in which you fight against your impending fate. Princess Liliana is betrothed to the kingdom's crown prince as a hostage in order to secure peace between the kingdom and the principality. One day, at a ball, the prince, having found a new lover, unilaterally breaks off the engagement and falsely accuses her of operating a gambling den for profit and embezzlement. Exiled and sent to the frontier, Liliana is attacked and killed along the way... only to find herself transported back to the day before the ball! Liliana works hard to gather evidence to avoid being falsely accused, and with the help of a mysterious man named Zeke, she successfully infiltrates the gambling den. However, her life is targeted there as well, and both of them lose their lives. Who is the culprit relentlessly pursuing Liliana's life...? To put an end to the cycle of death, Liliana and Zeke's battle begins now! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
